attempted_axis: Re-screen of the legacy DrawStringTextMLines park against the current corpus. The park classified the residual REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE; --ops shows the opcode multiset DIFFERS, so it is STRUCTURAL. Four induction-variable source shapes probed; residual reduced to ONE named mechanism.

attributes.axis_log: Residual isolated to ONE instruction at fn+0x1f4..0x1f8, the initialisation of the strength-reduced byte-offset induction variable for `lines[line]`. Target: `li r30,0 ; addi r27,r30,0 ; addi r29,r1,148` - the offset IV is initialised by COPYING the counter's register. AXIS1 current chained form `line = (msgLine = 0)` -> `li r30,0 ; addi r29,r1,148 ; slwi r27,r30,2`: MWCC emits the general scale-by-4 form because the counter's initial value is not constant-folded (real 2, the retained best). AXIS2 split `msgLine = 0; line = 0;` -> the init folds to `li r27,0` and the base address reorders, REGRESSED real 2 -> 4. AXIS3 copy form `msgLine = 0; line = msgLine;` produced an IDENTICAL ops diff to AXIS2 - two identical A/Bs, axis killed by the AGENTS rule. AXIS4 two-IV byte-offset walk (`lineOff = (line = 0)` with `*(s32*)((u8*)lines + lineOff)` and `lineOff += 4`) REGRESSED to real 15 and 149 instructions - MWCC collapsed it into a walked pointer (`lwz` replacing the target's `lwzx`), which DISPROVES the hypothesis that the target's scale-1 copy implies a raw byte-offset source, and means no fakematch offset walk is warranted here. AXIS5 two parallel counters (`msgLine = (line = 0)`, index with msgLine, increment both) byte-NEUTRAL - MWCC unifies the counters. AXIS6 explicit base pointer `lp = lines; ... lp[line]` REGRESSED real 2 -> 12 by forcing a persistent register web for lp.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.chained-init-constant-share.20260829.v1 APPLIED as the diagnosis for why AXIS1 beats AXIS2/AXIS3 - the chained assignment stops the counter's zero from being constant-folded into the derived IV, which is what keeps the shift form instead of the worse `li`. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction.20260830.v1 (core-screen) screened, not applicable: the source uses a plain `lines[line]` array index, no sizeof stride expression. claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression.20260830.v1 and claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe.20260830.v1 screened and CONFIRMED by AXIS6 and AXIS4 respectively - the pointer-walk form regressed exactly as the law predicts. claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention.20260830.v1 (core-screen) screened, not applicable: no load-update idiom in this loop. claim.law.declaration-initializer-split-controls-entry-schedule.20260830.v1 screened - AXIS2 is its split form and it measured worse, so the target is NOT deferring this initialiser. claim.law.single-use-field-pointer-alias-is-folded-away.20260831.v1 screened and inverted by AXIS6: `lp` has enough uses to survive, and surviving is what hurt. No law in the corpus covers derived-IV init materialisation; `laws --query "temp register"` and the scratch-allocation searches returned nothing.
attributes.residual: ONE mechanism, STRUCTURAL but single-instruction: how MWCC materialises the zero initial value of the strength-reduced offset induction variable. Target copies the counter's register (`addi r27,r30,0`, scale 1); ours emits either the general shift (`slwi r27,r30,2`) when the counter's init is not folded, or a fresh constant (`li r27,0`) when it is. No probed source form produced the copy. Plus one unscored line: `lfd f1,sBTextIntBias` - the 0x4330000080000000 int-to-double bias emitted by the (f32)MBFontHeight cast expansion, compiler-generated and not source-reachable; confirmed unscored by objdiff (fuzzy is 99.5267%, less than one instruction of penalty, all of it the slwi).
attributes.scope: No retained change. src/game/ui/btext.c restored to its committed state via git checkout after the final probe; verified clean with git status.
attributes.unpark_condition: A source form that makes MWCC initialise a strength-reduced offset IV by copying the counter register rather than shifting or re-materialising it. Six shapes are now recorded as dead - do not re-run them. Re-classification note for future screens: the legacy park called this REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE; it is STRUCTURAL (opcode multiset DIFFERS, target-only +1 addi, ours-only -1 slwi), so it is NOT eligible for the WebFrank permutation path, which requires an identical multiset.
